decision: Proceed to collecting self-training material only if useful, algebraically verifiable model-proved material appears in at least two configurations; relation-only success supports a verifier-based search pilot, not whole-answer SFT. Twelve candidates do not establish enough diversity for training.
exclusions: No authoring references or target theorem supplied
feedback_policy: At most one pair each on DA05 and DA15: choose the first by sample order with a concretely refutable central claim. Same original answer; one continuation with only a counterexample/verdict for its own claim, one generic retry without verifier information. No correct target relation or proof supplied. If no suitable failure, skip. Exploratory matched retry, not powered causal study.
verification: Freeze extracted claims before fresh numerical tests. Reconstruct from primitive definitions; check generic symbolic residuals where possible. Classify false, verified, and unresolved separately; model proof and utility separately.
